title: Mouse and Plasma Tree
description: A small brown mouse stands on its hind legs on a wooden surface, reaching toward a glowing plasma ball device. The transparent sphere contains a central glowing orb with radiating blue beams connecting to vibrant green and pink leaves arranged in a tree-like pattern, set against a dark background with floating foliage.
prompt: A small brown mouse standing on its hind legs reaching up toward a large plasma ball device on a wooden surface. Inside the transparent sphere is a glowing central orb with bright blue electrical beams connecting to green and pink glowing leaves forming a spherical tree. Dark background with floating leaves and petals in purple and green, colorful paint splotches on the floor, whimsical surreal style, painterly digital art with visible brush strokes.
